{{Quote|Take a look at the stock. What can I get you?|Vince|<ref name="SWTOR" />}}
'''Vince''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who was alive during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. During the war he worked as a merchant on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Nal Hutta/Legends|Nal Hutta]],<ref name="SWTOR" /> the adopted [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Species/Legends|species]].<ref name="CodexHutta">{{TORcite|type=codex|Hutta}}</ref> On Hutta he owned a small stall in the market area of [[Jiguuna]],<ref name="SWTOR" /> an industrial town controlled by a Hutt [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] named [[Suudaa Nem'ro]].<ref name="CodexJiguuna">{{TORcite|type=codex|Jiguuna}}</ref> The stall consisted of a rack covered with the goods he sold, which consisted of various types of light [[Armor/Legends|armor]].<ref name="SWTOR" /> As all merchants in Jiguuna were, Vince was expected to pay some of his profits from his stall to one of Nem'ro's lieutenants at the crime lord's [[Nem'ro's Palace|palace]].<ref name="CodexNem'roP">{{TORcite|type=codex|Nem'ro's palace}}</ref> Whilst at the stall the man wore [[Color/Legends|grey]] colored clothing and a [[Blaster pistol/Legends|blaster pistol]] on his hip. He also owned a device capable of displaying a holographic screen of data which he often consulted whilst at the stall. Vince had red colored hair including a beard, blue eyes and pale skin.<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Vince first appeared in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' released by [[BioWare]] in [[2011]]. He appears as a light armor vendor on the planet Nal Hutta, the starting planet for players of the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] and [[Imperial Agent]] class.
